script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars, your fiery ruling planet, is slamming a square into Saturn in Pisces today, rattling your 4th House of Home and the 10th House of Career. This clash is forcing you to confront old obligations versus your desire for bold action. In love, Venus in Gemini sextiles Neptune, so a secret admirer may finally surface, but if you're partnered, watch for a partner misreading your directness as insensitivity. In your 2nd House of Money, unexpected expenses could arise—avoid impulsive spending on anything tied to emotional validation. The blessing? A surprise gift from a mentor connected to your 9th House of Expansion. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
